target_text: road bridge N of St. Sauveur
source_locator: R1620: PDF p. 24 (Mission Summary Report, 6 June 1944, Opsflash 1, Ops order 345), PDF p. 4 (Record of Events, p. 3)
notes: Context: the Mission Summary Report: the 395th Fighter Bomber Squadron, Lt. Col. Perego leading, 16 P-47s, aborts nil; up 0525, TOT 0612, down 0710; one direct hit observed, bombs well concentrated; a 30-vehicle convoy south of St. Sauveur strafed. The group's first invasion mission (Record of Events). Location: no target place (the report names "St. Sauveur" only; Saint-Sauveur-le-Vicomte (PL0339) and Saint-Sauveur-Lendelin (PL0338) are both in the Cotentin, and the report's flak at Carteret does not decide between them). Review: the Record of Events gives take-off at 0520 and over the target at 0612; the Mission Summary Report gives up 0525, and its time is entered. Review: confidence 0.7, one primary record (the group's monthly historical report for June 1944 with its Mission Summary Reports, AFHRA copy, read from the page images); figures only where the record gives them; added in the Normandy chunk 5d pilot (branch normandy-ninthaf-5d, 17 November 2026): old value none, new value this mission row; reason: J1 (Scott, 17 November 2026). Review: unit_id old value US-FG-368, new value US-FS-395; reason: Scott (17 November 2026): when a single squadron flies a mission, the row uses the squadron id; the Mission Summary Report names the 395th Fighter Bomber Squadron as the flying unit.
